text: わたしの　かれ　いつも　いそがしい　から　ひとりで　およぎに　きてるんだ！

structure.jp: わたしの　かれ　いつも　いそがしい　から
structure.en: my boyfriend is always busy, so

structure.jp: ひとりで　およぎに　きてるんだ！

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because', with the result coming next. いそがしい　から = 'because he's busy'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after the stem of a verb, followed by a verb of coming or going, tells what you come to do. およぎに　きてる = 'have come to swim'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている with a verb like 'come' says you came and are still here. てる is the shortened spoken form. きてる = 'have come and am here'.
